seguimientos.help.title: Follow-ups
seguimientos.help.intro: Follow-ups organizes work that needs human action: decisions, replies, approvals, and next steps. It is the first resident of Limbo, the neutral space between worlds. The screen always reads a copy saved on disk; it never queries Zoho live while you view it.
seguimientos.help.first.title: First steps
seguimientos.help.first.step1: Read Today's summary to find overdue, blocked, and changed items since your last visit.
seguimientos.help.first.step2: Sort or filter Niko's Tickets and open a row to review its details.
seguimientos.help.first.step3: Use the table checkboxes to mark the tickets you want to work on.
seguimientos.help.first.step4: Review due dates and meetings in Calendar; each dot opens that day's details.
seguimientos.help.first.step5: Use Updates, Work on selected, or Standup when you want to open a session with that context.

seguimientos.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
seguimientos.help.buttons.aiview.v: Filters the dashboard from a phrase. It uses AI and consumes tokens.
seguimientos.help.buttons.scan.v: Opens a session to review changes across sources; that session consumes tokens.
seguimientos.help.buttons.bulk.v: Opens a session with the checked tickets and consumes tokens while it works.
seguimientos.help.buttons.refresh.v: Updates the Desk copy through the read-only Aduana and then reads the saved snapshot again. It is deterministic and consumes no tokens.
seguimientos.help.buttons.classify.v: Classifies the snapshot again with AI; it consumes tokens.
seguimientos.help.buttons.project.v: Groups rows by project without modifying tickets.
seguimientos.help.buttons.mine.v: Shows only tickets assigned to you or marked as yours.
seguimientos.help.buttons.table.v: Headers sort; the second row filters; checkboxes build the work selection.
seguimientos.help.buttons.row.v: Opens properties, people, times, description, and the link to the Zoho ticket.
seguimientos.help.buttons.resolve.v: Opens a session with the ticket details; it consumes tokens.
seguimientos.help.buttons.calendar.v: Changes month or opens the large calendar with due dates and meetings.
seguimientos.help.buttons.day.v: Opens that day's tickets and meetings; Outlook events are informational.
seguimientos.help.buttons.standup.v: Opens a session with the standup overview and consumes tokens.
seguimientos.help.buttons.collapse.v: Collapse or expand Summary, Tickets, Metrics, Calendar, and Standup.
seguimientos.help.buttons.help.v: Opens this guide without changing filters or selections.
seguimientos.help.warning.title: Watch out for this
seguimientos.help.warning.text: The dashboard does not resolve or publish anything on its own. Sessions opened here can read several sources, but they may write only to the ticket and must always ask for your explicit approval first.
seguimientos.help.warning.limbo: Limbo cross-references information in read-only mode without synchronizing worlds: any write is limited to the ticket and requires your explicit approval.
